title: Drive from the subsystem
summary: Fill in updateLogic so the drivetrain subsystem drives with the sticks.

say.never: The drive code moves out of Robot.java and into the subsystem. Hold down **Ctrl** and tap **P**. A small search box pops up at the top. Type `DrivetrainSubsystem`, then press **Enter**. It finds any file by its name, so you never have to dig through folders.
say.bit: The drive code moves out of Robot.java and into the subsystem. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `DrivetrainSubsystem` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

say.never: Click in the code, then hold **Ctrl** and tap **F** to open the search box. Type `drive with arcade drive` and press **Enter**. The editor scrolls to the right spot and highlights it.
say.bit: Press **Ctrl+F**, type `drive with arcade drive` and press Enter to jump to it.

target.text: drive with arcade drive using the driver's sticks

waitFor.hint: find drive with arcade drive with Ctrl+F.

say.never: Now write the line the comment asks for: `drive.arcadeDrive(OI.getForward(), OI.getTurn());`. It goes right under the comment, inside `updateLogic`. `updateLogic` runs every 20 thousandths of a second, so this line re-reads the sticks and drives the robot over and over while you drive. Ask `OI` for the sticks; never talk to the controller directly.
